matter_spring_and.name: Matter / AND / gravity — earn the reusable assembly
matter_spring_and.label: Matter / AND / gravity — earn the reusable assembly
matter_spring_and.description: A one-metre timber slope with a 30cm rise supplies the motion. Lift the pink stop: Jolt simulates the white balls, falling input cubes on slider guides, and a motor-free hinged impact target. No spring launch, prescribed ball velocity or input seating snap. Double working size on a reachable platform.
matter_spring_and.qfep_connection: The expected truth table is separate from material evidence. Gravity, an inclined plank, released supports and real contact determine whether the ball reaches its target.
